PBMC_independence: one external file; independent study/donor/pretraining overlap unknown

upstream_SAE.topk: largest raw activation VALUES; no absolute ranking/ReLU/L1; keep original signed values
upstream_SAE.decoder_columns: unit norm after each Adam update
upstream_SAE.initialization: unit random decoder columns; encoder weight=decoder.T initially, encoder bias0; untied training
upstream_SAE.preprocess_sae: subtract fixed TRAIN mean only; no input channel scaling
upstream_SAE.probe: TRAIN StandardScaler + balanced eight-class RidgeClassifier-equivalent exact eigensolve; linear only
upstream_SAE.probe_selection: best VALID macroF1; first ascending-alpha tie; fit TRAIN only, no refit TRAIN+VALID
upstream_SAE.sae_selection: lowest VALID raw MSE, earliest tie; epoch0 eligible
upstream_SAE.baseline: deterministic Ridge; reused across K/seeds, not independent optimizer replicates
upstream_SAE.train_rows: all eligible cells in four TRAIN donors; original donor roles; no class cap
upstream_SAE.macro_f1: fixed eight labels, zero_division=0; absent TEST class contributes0; supported-type macro diagnostic separately
upstream_SAE.pbmc: full eligible PBMC368k_raw4638cell local dataset; no fitting/selection
upstream_SAE.r2: 1-SSE/sum||h-mean_of_evaluation_split||²; metric denominator only, not fitted preprocessing
upstream_SAE.scope: historically explored donor and PBMC data; independent file not confirmed independent study/pretraining
